title: kbask ask ITEM reaches the item's running worker session, not the orchestrator that claimed it
goal: kbask ask with an item id addresses the session dispatch started for the item while it runs, and the claimer's only when no worker runs; SP-3pvz2noj: an ask to ST-xjtqwdtq went to the orchestrator's own session and was re-sent by session id

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import inspect, kbask
assert 'dispatch' in inspect.getsource(kbask), 'ask resolves an item to its claimer only'
